summary: Verified admin logout redirect bug fix and AdminLoginPage redesign. Both work as specified. Login → dashboard shows 'Hey Admin! Selamat pagi.' greeting with gradient stat cards. Clicking 'Keluar' navigates to `/` and Huniaja homepage renders (hero banner, QuickCategories, property cards). AdminLoginPage renders new elegant design: soft gradient (white → indigo-50 → green-50) with mesh blobs, glass card with backdrop-blur, 'Kembali ke Beranda' link (href='/') + Huniaja blue logo in header, 'PANEL ADMIN' badge, Lock icon in white box, 'Admin Huniaja' title, email + password inputs with icons, password eye toggle, gradient navy→blue submit button. Verified on desktop 1920x900 and mobile 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboardPage.jsx is 723 lines — consider splitting StatsPanel / PropertiesPanel / BannersPanel / ArticlesPanel into separate module files for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: AdminDashboardPage logout() calls navigate('/') which correctly lands on the public Huniaja homepage. AdminLoginPage was fully redesigned to match public LoginPage aesthetic and matches spec. data-testids present: admin-login-back, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, admin-logout, admin-tab-stats.
